text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo seemed to lack her usual 
vitality for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: King looks like she's not feeling well...

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You've been working so hard lately... The 
fatigue must be catching up with you...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! You clumsy little bunch! It's 
really no big deal at all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as if the King could ever be worn 
out! Come, let's do one more light run—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"M-My legs just got tangled for a 
second...! There's no need for unnecessary 
concern!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though she's putting on a brave face, 
it's plain to see King Halo is exhausted. 
It might be wise to reconsider her race 
schedule..."
